faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can a complete beginner start from zero?
faq.a1: Absolutely! The course starts with Hangul foundations, stroke order guides, and clear pronunciation videos.
faq.a2: SRS predicts when you're about to forget a word and tests you right before, transferring knowledge into long-term memory.
faq.q3: Can I use it on mobile?
faq.a3: Yes! JungHyeon is a Progressive Web App (PWA) with responsive mobile design that installs directly to your home screen.
faq.q4: How do I get personal course advice?
faq.a4: Leave your phone number or book a consultation via the bottom Support button. We'll contact you within 15 minutes.
